shortDescription: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust (IOIG.KL) fell 4.4% in its Malaysia market debut on Wednesday after its backer IOI Properties Group MYX:IOIPG raised about 2 billion ringgit ($486.3 million) by selling units in the property fund.($1 = 4.1130 ringgit)

children: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust (IOIG.KL) fell 4.4% in its Malaysia market debut on Wednesday after its backer IOI Properties Group
raised about 2 billion ringgit ($486.3 million) by selling units in the property fund.
IOIPG REIT opened at 87 sen per unit, versus its offer price of 91 sen. Malaysia's benchmark KLCI
The offering involved the sale of 2.2 billion existing units, or 40% of IOIPG REIT's 5.5 billion units
The proceeds will go to IOI Properties, the REIT's sponsor and largest unitholder. IOI Properties will retain a 60% stake in the REIT after the listing

IOIPG REIT owns a portfolio of nine freehold properties valued at about 7.66 billion ringgit, which includes IOI City Mall in Putrajaya, six hotels, including W Kuala Lumpur and Le Méridien Putrajaya, and office buildings in Putrajaya and Puchong in Malaysia
The REIT forecast an annualised distribution yield of 6.96% based on its offer price of 91 sen. A distribution yield is the annual cash payout to investors as a percentage of the unit price
It expects distributable income of 280.5 million ringgit for the period from September 11, 2026 to June 30, 2027, and plans to distribute at least 90% of distributable income
